goal: Finish the existing bilingual local-executor guides for actual use. The drafts were written by earlier Codex invocations that timed out before returning a structured handoff; their output is not yet accepted. Inspect the actual CLI and relevant code, preserve correct content, and add a short first-run checklist near the beginning of each guide. The checklist must cover preparing Python/dependencies, confirming existing ChatGPT authentication, creating a real task, validating it, running it, and inspecting the resulting run_id/report before considering resume. Keep the existing links, examples and truthful limits/pending integrations. Fix concrete factual errors if found. Return the structured result when this focused assignment is done. Modify only the two guides; do not expand scope or recreate them from scratch.
acceptance_criteria: Both guides explain the actual implemented CLI with valid command names and directory flags.
Both guides explain task configuration, bounded account-based execution, role results and authoritative checks.
Both guides describe isolation, evidence invalidation, interruption handling and currently pending integrations accurately.
Documentation follows separate English and Portuguese directories, linking its counterpart.
Both guides begin with an actionable first-run checklist consistent with the actual CLI and role boundaries.
